name: Unified audit search
description: Searches the unified audit log by user, operation, record type, object or free text.

parameters.name: UserIds
parameters.label: Users
parameters.help: Sign-in names of the people who acted.

parameters.name: Operations
parameters.label: Operations
parameters.help: Operation names, for example MailItemsAccessed or FileDeleted.

parameters.name: RecordType
parameters.label: Record type
parameters.help: One record type, for example ExchangeItem or SharePointFileOperation.

parameters.name: ObjectIds
parameters.label: Objects
parameters.help: Object IDs or URLs the action was on.

parameters.name: FreeText
parameters.label: Free text
parameters.help: Text to find anywhere in the audit record.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.label: Maximum rows
parameters.help: Stops after this many records and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later, audit logging enabled, and the View-Only Audit Logs role.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Audit retention depends on licence; older records may not exist.
AuditData longer than 8,000 characters is truncated and marked.
